rows.heading: Time-Bound Promotion Channel (E1→E4)
rows.quote_snippet: 2.1 Qualifying Residency Requirements: Promotions within the junior executive ranks (E1 through E4) shall be governed by the Time-Bound Promotion Channel subject to completing prescribed residency and meeting the APAR benchmark: (a) Promotion from E1 to E2: 3 (three) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E1.
